turns.prompt: Fit the nonlinear model y = (b1/b2) * exp[-0.5*((x-b3)/b2)**2] to the data in eckerle4.csv (columns x, y) by least squares, starting from b1 = 1, b2 = 10, b3 = 500. Report every parameter (b1, b2, b3) to at least 6 significant digits and the residual sum of squares as rss.

provenance: NIST StRD Eckerle4 (public domain), data copied verbatim
